// REQ: LANG-2081 LANG-2082 LANG-2083 LANG-2084
// Instruction definitions
class Inst<string asm, list<dag> pattern> {
  string AsmString = asm;
  list<dag> Pattern = pattern;
  bits<8> Opcode = 0x1F;
}
let isBranch = 1 in
def JMP : Inst<"jmp $dst", []>;
defvar count = !add(1, 2);
def ADD : Inst<"add $a, $b", [(set GPR:$a, (add GPR:$a, GPR:$b))]>;
